name: United States (33 stars, 1859–1861)
description: Thirteen alternating red and white stripes with a navy canton bearing thirty-three white five-pointed stars in five rows of 7, 7, 5, 7 and 7.
history: The 33-star flag became official on 4 July 1859 after the admission of Oregon. It was the flag that flew over Fort Sumter when the fort was bombarded in April 1861 at the start of the Civil War; the Union never removed the stars of the seceded states. It was replaced on 4 July 1861 by the 34-star flag for Kansas.
